derived_comparison.common_observation: All three snapshots show long-dominated liquidations; TradRadar and Liqwall report OI contraction. Funding is positive in the two current aggregate readings, but venue-level values differ.
disagreements: OI differs by almost 2x across aggregators.
24-hour liquidation totals differ: at least $6.85M at TradRadar, $3.8M at Liqwall and $6.7414M from Alpha's displayed long/short components.
Spot reference prices differ because the provider timestamps are not synchronized.
Coverage differs by exchange and metric; TradRadar uses seven venues for OI but five for liquidations/long-short, Liqwall has its own venue universe, and Alpha's Binance map is unavailable.
derived_comparison.interpretation: Long crowding and deleveraging are supported as descriptive conditions. They do not determine the next price move. A downside continuation hypothesis competes with a stabilization/mean-reversion hypothesis if spot bids absorb the liquidation flow.
derived_comparison.model_eligibility: descriptive cross-check only; not admitted as synchronized model feature
